title: Foundation: reproducible workspaces, contracts and safe local stack
body:
## Scope

Implement the agreed support-flow portfolio scope for a single trusted human reviewer, with synthetic public demo and separately configured local services.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Create an npm workspace monorepo with exact dependency versions, a committed lockfile, TypeScript shared DTOs/schemas and documented Node 22 LTS commands.
- [ ] Provide Docker Compose with pinned n8n, PostgreSQL/pgvector, API and Mailpit, readiness checks, persistent volumes, and separate app/n8n database schemas or databases.
- [ ] Commit .env.example containing fake placeholders only; ignore local secrets, runtime data and build output. Browser builds contain no server/provider credential.
- [ ] Fresh-clone install, contract build, API startup, safe synthetic seed and Mailpit delivery sink are documented and exercised. Gmail sending requires explicit credentials/configuration.
- [ ] CI uses least-privileged permissions and the supported Node runtime. Authored code uses MIT; describe n8n's independent licensing accurately.

## Required review evidence

Record dependency/runtime versions, fresh-clone commands and successful readiness/build/seed evidence. Include negative evidence for missing secrets and no browser credential leakage.

Do not claim production readiness, real-provider execution, or successful delivery without observed evidence.

title: API: durable tickets and version-bound human review
body:
## Scope

Implement the agreed support-flow portfolio scope for a single trusted human reviewer, with synthetic public demo and separately configured local services.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Implement /health and /api/v1 ticket/review endpoints with validated DTOs, bounded request sizes, secure reviewer sessions and independent workflow bearer authentication under /internal/v1.
- [ ] Persist tickets, drafts, audit events and dispatch outbox in PostgreSQL; concurrent duplicate externalId submissions create one ticket.
- [ ] Bind edits and approvals to expectedVersion. Stale edit/approve, rejected tickets and double approval return explicit errors; revision invalidates prior approval.
- [ ] Dispatch approved content through a transaction-safe outbox, recover pending work after restart, and classify ambiguous delivery for human attention without blind resend.
- [ ] Provide meaningful unit and real database integration tests covering unauthorized access, malformed inputs, duplicate races, stale/rejected/double approval and restart/recovery.

## Required review evidence

Attach endpoint examples and actual database test results. Show recorded audit state transitions and a restart/ambiguous-delivery test; disclose any unsupported delivery guarantees.

Do not claim production readiness, real-provider execution, or successful delivery without observed evidence.

title: Automation: executable n8n retrieval, drafting, dispatch and recovery
body:
## Scope

Implement the agreed support-flow portfolio scope for a single trusted human reviewer, with synthetic public demo and separately configured local services.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Commit importable n8n workflows for KB ingestion, ticket intake/triage/draft, approved dispatch and error recovery. n8n must execute the workflow graph.
- [ ] Retrieve fictional KB passages from PostgreSQL/pgvector, call OpenAI Responses with structured output, and validate cited IDs against retrieved sources before publishing a draft.
- [ ] Bound provider timeouts, retries, tokens and call counts. Handle refusal, rate limits, invalid responses and unavailable retrieval; sensitive/unknown or missing-information requests route to human review.
- [ ] Authenticate webhook/internal callbacks to prevent open relays. Slack and Gmail are optional credentials; Mailpit is the default local sink and browser/provider credentials never mix.
- [ ] Run actual n8n container integration tests against controlled provider fixtures proving topology, output persistence and negative cases, with opt-in live-provider smoke separately labeled and documented.

## Required review evidence

Report pinned n8n version, workflow execution IDs/results, fixture request counts and failure outcomes. Live provider results must only be claimed if run; record cost/usage when available. Document credential import and licensing.

Do not claim production readiness, real-provider execution, or successful delivery without observed evidence.

title: React: accessible review workspace and honest public sample demo
body:
## Scope

Implement the agreed support-flow portfolio scope for a single trusted human reviewer, with synthetic public demo and separately configured local services.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Build React/Vite/TypeScript inbox with filters/search and details containing original message, retrieval sources, draft edit, approve/reject and audit timeline using shared DTOs.
- [ ] Use explicit demo/live adapters. Public Pages sample mode prominently states synthetic data/no email sending and never calls providers directly.
- [ ] Provide routine, missing-information and sensitive scenarios; persist demo state across reload and expose reset. Reject and stale/version-conflict actions show useful messages.
- [ ] Support mobile/desktop and keyboard navigation, visible focus, labels and readable empty/error/loading states. Do not invent provider usage metrics or live integrations.
- [ ] Add meaningful component tests and Playwright coverage for edit, approve, reject, filters, reload/reset and responsive keyboard flows.

## Required review evidence

Attach test results and actual application screenshot(s). Demonstrate deployed sample actions without provider requests, JS errors or credential disclosure.

Do not claim production readiness, real-provider execution, or successful delivery without observed evidence.

title: Quality and documentation: independently verify the complete support flow
body:
## Scope

Implement the agreed support-flow portfolio scope for a single trusted human reviewer, with synthetic public demo and separately configured local services.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Build independent integration/e2e coverage exercising actual n8n, PostgreSQL, API and UI together rather than only mocks or workflow JSON inspection.
- [ ] Cover duplicate intake races, reviewer auth failures, stale approval, restart recovery, provider refusal/error, citation rejection and ambiguous dispatch recovery.
- [ ] Provide approximately 30 clearly fictional ticket examples and a fictional support KB with grounded evaluation labels and documented limitations.
- [ ] README has two obvious paths: Try demo and Run boilerplate. Document setup, credentials, workflow import, seed/reset, test commands, architecture, costs, security, single-reviewer deployment scope and failure recovery.
- [ ] Use an actual app screenshot and honest validation report distinguishing controlled fixture integrations from opt-in live-provider smoke. Every advertised command must be executable.

## Required review evidence

Provide exact test commands, pass/fail counts and environment limitations. Include a reproducible end-to-end trace and verify documentation on a fresh checkout.

Do not claim production readiness, real-provider execution, or successful delivery without observed evidence.

title: Release: verified CI and GitHub Pages deployment
body:
## Scope

Implement the agreed support-flow portfolio scope for a single trusted human reviewer, with synthetic public demo and separately configured local services.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Run CI on supported runtime with locked install, builds, unit tests, real database/n8n integration and Playwright. Use minimum permissions and immutable deployment artifact.
- [ ] Deploy Pages only from verified main with Vite base /support-flow/. Preserve PR review history and link implementation PRs to their issues.
- [ ] Verify the actual deployed URL in desktop and mobile browsers: assets/base path, edit/approve/reject/reset/reload behavior, keyboard access and no JS errors.
- [ ] Check public bundle for credentials and network traffic for accidental live provider calls; visible sample-mode/no-send disclosure remains present.
- [ ] Record deployed commit SHA, Actions run, deployment URL and actual live-demo checks. Close only acceptance criteria supported by evidence; document unresolved gaps plainly.

## Required review evidence

Supply exact commit/run/deployment URLs and browser checks with screenshots. CI failures or unavailable environments are blockers to any claim of complete release verification.

Do not claim production readiness, real-provider execution, or successful delivery without observed evidence.
